7.4.3.2.1 Receive data consistency (Master only)
[SWS_Lin_00211] ⌈The complete LIN frame receive processing (including copying to
destination layer) can be implemented in the Lin_GetStatus function. The received
data shall be consistent until either next LIN frame has been received successfully or
LIN channel state has changed.⌋
